extensionDescription.message: Translate entire web pages in one click — preserves links, images and layout. Works with Google (free) and Azure Translator.

autoTranslateDesc.message: When a page's language differs from your target language, translate it automatically

commandToggleDescription.message: Toggle translation of the current page

optionsSubtitle.message: Translate entire pages while preserving links, images and layout

defaultLanguageDesc.message: The language used when you click "Translate page"

engineDesc.message: Google's free endpoint works out of the box; MyMemory is verified and serves as an independent fallback; Lingva availability varies by region; Azure Translator suits users with a subscription key

apiKeyPlaceholder.message: Paste your Azure Translator resource key

apiKeyHint.message: Create a Translator resource in the Azure Portal to get a key. The legacy free Bing endpoint stopped working in Nov 2026, so this engine now requires a key.

howToUseStep1.message: Click the toolbar icon to open the popup

howToUseStep2.message: Pick your target language and engine

howToUseStep4.message: Right-click any selection to translate just that text

customPresetHint.message: Choosing a preset fills in the endpoint and template below. Replace the URL with your own service. A self-hosted DeepLX / LibreTranslate / OpenAI-compatible relay is usually more reliable than public free endpoints.

customUrlHint.message: Saving or testing asks for permission to access this origin. When the URL is empty the engine is unavailable and the fallback chain skips it.

customTemplateHint.message: Placeholders: {{text}} raw text, {{textJson}} JSON-quoted text, {{from}}/{{to}} language codes, {{toName}} language name, {{token}}, {{model}}

offlineTranslationDesc.message: Translated locally by your browser's built-in model; text never leaves the device. The model for a language pair downloads on first use.

blacklistHint.message: One host per line; supports *.example.com and /path prefixes. Matching sites are never translated — useful for banking, admin consoles, and code hosting.

useOfflineDesc.message: Chrome's built-in AI translates locally — no network, no rate limits; skipped automatically on Edge. Turn off to always use online engines.

translatedStyleHint.message: Visually distinguish translations from source text. Applied via data attributes without changing the page DOM.

lazyTranslateDesc.message: Translate what you scroll to, so the first screen is ready instantly. Turn off to translate the whole page at once.

engineInfoOffline.message: Built-in on-device translation enabled · local inference, no network, no rate limits

pageUnsupportedDetailed.message: This page can't be translated (open a regular web page)

statusPartialFailed.message: $FAILED$ blocks weren't translated; click again to retry

engineInfoPageOffline.message: This page uses built-in on-device translation · local inference, no network, no rate limits

engineInfoOnline.message: This page uses the online engine: $NAME$ (change it in settings)

engineInfoUnknown.message: Couldn't detect the translation mode; try translating anyway

offlineStatusUnavailable.message: On-device translation isn't available in this browser or page; the online engine below will be used (Chrome 138+ / Edge 148+)

offlineStatusUnknown.message: Can't check (open any web page first)

customUrlInvalid.message: The endpoint URL isn't a valid http(s) URL

permissionTimeout.message: Permission request timed out (the prompt was closed or isn't supported here)

permissionDenied.message: Domain access wasn't granted, so the browser will block translation requests

engineOptionLingva.message: Lingva (Google mirror, availability varies by region)

probeFailed.message: Probe failed (you can still try translating)

azureKeyRequiredExpired.message: An Azure Translator key is required (the free endpoint was retired in Nov 2026)

azureKeyRequired.message: An Azure Translator key is required

customUrlMissing.message: No endpoint URL configured (Settings → Engine → Custom endpoint)

probeFailedNamed.message: The $NAME$ probe failed (you can still try translating)

blockedByBlacklist.message: This site is on the never-translate list (Settings → Preferences)

pageAlreadyChinese.message: The page is already in Chinese; nothing to do

pageNoText.message: No translatable text on this page

pageAlreadyTarget.message: The page is already in the target language; nothing to do

indicatorPreparingOffline.message: Translating… (preparing the on-device model; using the online engine for now)

translatePartlyDone.message: $FAILED$ of $TOTAL$ blocks weren't translated, usually due to rate limits or network hiccups; click Retranslate to fill them in

translateEchoed.message: $COUNT$ blocks were left as-is because the engine considered them already target-language, usually mixed Chinese/English text

translateSuspended.message: Stopped after $COUNT$ batches in a row returned no usable response ($DETAIL$)

backgroundTimeout.message: The background page didn't respond in time

offlineUnsupported.message: This browser doesn't support on-device translation

offlineUnsupportedLong.message: This browser doesn't support on-device translation (Chrome 138+ / Edge 148+)
